title: CRUD API with OpenAPI and Postgres
description: Serve a typed CRUD API from Lakebase Postgres, with Zod schemas that validate requests and generate OpenAPI 3.1 docs and Swagger UI.

environment.name: BOOKMARKS_API_TOKEN
environment.description: A random token of at least 32 characters, for example from openssl rand -hex 32, that callers send as Authorization: Bearer <token> on POST, PATCH, and DELETE. It is required because Neon Function URLs are public.
